entries.text: TPC-DS data maintenance now runs on SingleStore. All eleven maintenance functions (LF_CR, LF_CS, LF_I, LF_SR, LF_SS, LF_WR, LF_WS, DF_CS, DF_SS, DF_WS, DF_I) completed against SingleStore 10.9.0 at SF0.01 and report rows affected; the three return functions parse the refresh return time with CAST(... AS SIGNED) on MySQL-wire dialects, because SingleStore rejects CAST(... AS INTEGER). A SingleStore job in the Docker integration workflow now runs the live SingleStore tests nightly and on pull requests that touch the SingleStore platform or its compose stack.
